verdicts.reason: The text says to "use project-relative paths for references in documentation", so an absolute /tmp/speckit-sdd/ path left in research breaks that rule.
The text says to "use project-relative paths for references in documentation", which applies to quickstart the same way and rules out /tmp/speckit-sdd/ paths.
"Plan workflow executed and design artifacts generated" requires a plan artifact at minimum.
"design artifacts generated" includes research.md, which the plan workflow always produces.
"design artifacts generated" does not name data-model specifically, and a data model is usually only needed when entities exist, so a hard must is stricter than written.
The text says "**Setup**: Run `.../setup-tasks.sh --json`" as the first step of the tasks stage.
"Generate tasks organized by user story" supports checking that story tasks carry story labels.
"One phase per user story (in priority order from spec.md)" directly supports a phase-order check.
"Each phase includes: ... tests (if requested)", together with line 43's "every user story gets test tasks", supports a should-level story-tests check.
"Keep the Setup, Foundational and Polish phase headings even when a phase has no task; such a phase holds the one line `No tasks — <reason>`" is an explicit requirement.
"All tasks must follow the strict checklist format" supports requiring each checkbox line to carry a unique T### ID.
"Tasks MUST be organized by user story" directly supports the story_tasks rule.
"every user story gets test tasks under `### Tests for User Story N`" directly supports this check.
"ALWAYS start with `- [ ]`" applies to task lines, but of_pattern `T\d{3}` also catches non-task lines that just mention IDs, such as dependency notes, so the check is stricter than written.
"Sequential number (T001, T002, T003...) in execution order" supports the sequence and uniqueness check.
"Include ONLY if task is parallelizable (different files, ...)" supports checking that [P] tasks touch different files.
"[US1], [US2], [US3], etc. (maps to user stories from spec.md)" supports a should-level check that every label maps to a story in spec.md.
"Setup phase: NO story label ... Foundational phase: NO story label ... Polish phase: NO story label" directly supports this check.
"User Story phases: MUST have story label" is explicit.
"Each user story (P1, P2, P3...) gets its own phase" supports checking that every spec story has a matching phase heading in tasks.
